name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with go-karts in his hometown of Medellin. His passion for precision led him to pursue mechanical engineering, where he excelled in materials science and quality assurance. Before transitioning to racing, Ricardo spent years in the aerospace industry, ensuring the reliability of critical components. This experience instilled in him an unwavering commitment to detail and a zero-tolerance approach to defects.

In motorsport, Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach to quality control. He believes that even the smallest imperfection can have catastrophic consequences on the track. He's renowned for his ability to quickly identify potential weaknesses in a car's design or construction, and he works tirelessly to ensure that every component meets the highest standards. Ricardo is a firm believer in preventative maintenance and continuous improvement, always seeking ways to optimize performance and minimize risk.

What sets Ricardo apart is his ability to remain calm and collected under pressure. Even in the most stressful situations, he maintains a clear head and focuses on finding solutions. His calm demeanor and unwavering dedication to quality make him an invaluable asset to any racing team.

physical.description: Ricardo is a man of average height, with a serious but kind face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Insists on using calibrated tools, even for seemingly minor tasks.
Has a habit of cleaning his glasses meticulously when under stress.
